Class FieldReplicationServiceTest

@IsTest
private class FieldReplicationServiceTest

Test class for FieldReplicationService. Validates bidirectional field replication functionality between parent and child records, including field mapping from parent to child and child from parent using metadata-driven configuration.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void copyLeadRecordTest()

Tests the copyRecords() method for copying Lead records to LeadArchive__c records. Validates that when given a set of Lead record IDs, the method correctly creates LeadArchive__c records with field values copied from the source leads based on the COPY_LEAD_LEADARCHIVE metadata configuration.

Since:
    01/11/2026

@IsTest
private static void copyNotFoundRecordsTest()

Tests the copyRecords() method when source records are not found. Validates that when given a set of IDs that do not match any records in the source object, the method returns an empty array without errors.

Since:
    12/20/2025

@IsTest
private static void copyRecordsTest()

Tests the copyRecords() method for creating target records from source records. Validates that when given a set of Bill__c record IDs, the method correctly creates VenuePayout__c records with field values copied from the source bills based on the COPY_BILL_VENUEPAYOUT metadata configuration.

Since:
    12/20/2025

@IsTest
private static void getAdditionalDataAsMapTest()

Tests the getAdditionalDataAsMap() method of the FieldReplicationService.Settings class. Validates that the method correctly deserializes the JSON string stored in the AdditionalData__c field of the metadata record into a Map<String, Object> for easy access to custom configuration parameters.

Since:
    11/07/2025

@IsTest
private static void replicateChildFromParentTest()

Tests field replication from parent records to child records. Validates that when child records reference a parent via lookup field, calling replicateChildFromParent() correctly copies field values from the parent (Payment2__c) to the child (BillPayment__c) based on metadata configuration.

@IsTest
private static void replicateParentToChildTest()

Tests field replication from parent records to all their related child records. Validates that when calling replicateParentToChild() on a parent record (Payment2__c), the service correctly queries all related child records (BillPayment__c) and updates their fields based on metadata configuration.
